with  __dbt__cte__raw__pos_weekly_sales as (

-- Fixture for pos_weekly_sales
select 
    
    cast('109' as character varying)
 as "store_nbr", 
    
    cast('41230001146' as character varying)
 as "upc", 
    
    cast('02/10/2024' as character varying)
 as "week_ending", 
    
    cast('-2' as character varying)
 as "units", 
    
    cast('-6.58' as character varying)
 as "gross_sales", 
    
    cast('0.00' as character varying)
 as "promo_discount", 
    
    cast('-6.58' as character varying)
 as "net_sales", 
    
    cast('fixture.csv' as character varying)
 as "_source_file", 
    
    cast(2 as BIGINT)
 as "_source_row"
), ranked as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by store_nbr, upc, week_ending, units, gross_sales, promo_discount, net_sales
            order by _source_row
        ) as replay_number
    from __dbt__cte__raw__pos_weekly_sales
),

typed as (
    select
        *,
        try_cast(store_nbr as integer) as store_id,
        lpad(trim(cast(upc as varchar)), 12, '0') as normalized_upc,
        coalesce(
            cast(try_strptime(week_ending, '%Y-%m-%d') as date),
            cast(try_strptime(week_ending, '%m/%d/%Y') as date)
        ) as parsed_week_ending,
        try_cast(units as integer) as parsed_units,
        try_cast(gross_sales as decimal(18, 2)) as parsed_gross_sales,
        try_cast(promo_discount as decimal(18, 2)) as parsed_promo_discount,
        try_cast(net_sales as decimal(18, 2)) as parsed_net_sales
    from ranked
)

select
    *,
    case
        when store_nbr = 'store_nbr' and upc = 'upc' then 'embedded_header'
        when replay_number > 1 then 'exact_replay'
        when
            store_id is null or parsed_week_ending is null or parsed_units is null
            or parsed_gross_sales is null or parsed_promo_discount is null or parsed_net_sales is null
            or not regexp_full_match(trim(upc), '[0-9]{11,12}') then 'invalid_record'
        else 'accepted'
    end as disposition
from typed

-- Each snapshotted key has at most one current version, and every closed version ends after it starts
-- and no later than the next version begins.
with versions as (
    select
        'snap_items' as snapshot_name,
        sku_id as entity_id,

    from "bramblewood"."main_snapshots"."snap_items"

        dbt_valid_to
    from "bramblewood"."main_snapshots"."snap_stores"
),

sequenced as (
    select
        *,
        lead(dbt_valid_from) over (
            partition by snapshot_name, entity_id order by dbt_valid_from
        ) as next_valid_from
    from versions
)

select
    snapshot_name,
    entity_id,
    'multiple current versions' as failure
from versions
where dbt_valid_to is null
group by snapshot_name, entity_id
having count(*) > 1
union all
select
    snapshot_name,
    entity_id,
    'invalid validity window' as failure
from sequenced
where
    dbt_valid_to <= dbt_valid_from
    or (next_valid_from is not null and (dbt_valid_to is null or dbt_valid_to > next_valid_from))

    vendor_id,
    status,
    mechanic,
    store_scope,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    display,
    vendor_scan_per_unit,
    vendor_display_fee,
    eligible_sales_rows,
    unambiguous_eligible_units,
    ambiguous_sales_rows,
    discounted_sales_rows,
    claim_count,
    scan_funding_owed_estimate,
    display_funding_owed_estimate,
    funding_owed_estimate,
    scan_amount_billed,
    display_fee_billed,
    total_billed,
    amount_collected,
    cast(funding_owed_estimate - total_billed as decimal(18, 2)) as owed_minus_billed_estimate,
    cast(total_billed - amount_collected as decimal(18, 2)) as uncollected_billed_amount,
    cast(funding_owed_estimate - amount_collected as decimal(18, 2)) as owed_minus_collected_estimate,
    status = 'Approved' and claim_count = 0 as approved_without_claim,
    status = 'Cancelled' and claim_count > 0 as billed_on_cancelled_event,
    case
        when status = 'Cancelled' then 'cancelled'
        when ambiguous_sales_rows > 0 then 'ambiguous_event_assignment'
        when eligible_sales_rows = 0 then 'no_observed_sales'
        when discounted_sales_rows = 0 then 'no_discount_execution_signal'
        else 'calendar_based_estimate'
    end as funding_estimate_status
from funding

-- Incremental runs restate whole fiscal weeks inside the lookback window: delete+insert on week_key
-- removes rows that disappeared from a corrected extract as well as replacing changed ones. Corrections
-- older than the window need `dbt build --full-refresh`; verify_repeatability.py proves the incremental
-- path reproduces a full build.
select

    store_key_matched,
    store_open,

    unit_cost,
    regular_unit_price,
    estimated_cogs,
    gross_profit_before_funding
from "bramblewood"."main"."int_sales_enriched"

-- Owed is a calendar-based estimate, not a confirmed receivable.
with event_inputs as (
    select
        p.promo_id,
        p.sku_id,
        p.vendor_id,
        p.status,
        p.mechanic,
        p.store_scope,
        p.start_date,
        p.end_date,
        p.display,
        p.vendor_scan_per_unit,
        p.vendor_display_fee,
        coalesce(e.eligible_sales_rows, 0) as eligible_sales_rows,
        coalesce(e.unambiguous_eligible_units, 0) as unambiguous_eligible_units,
        coalesce(e.ambiguous_sales_rows, 0) as ambiguous_sales_rows,
        coalesce(e.discounted_sales_rows, 0) as discounted_sales_rows,
        coalesce(c.claim_count, 0) as claim_count,
        coalesce(c.scan_amount_billed, 0::decimal(18, 2)) as scan_amount_billed,
        coalesce(c.display_fee_billed, 0::decimal(18, 2)) as display_fee_billed,
        coalesce(c.total_billed, 0::decimal(18, 2)) as total_billed,
        coalesce(c.amount_collected, 0::decimal(18, 2)) as amount_collected
    from "bramblewood"."main"."stg_promotions" as p
    left join "bramblewood"."main"."int_promotion_totals" as e on p.promo_id = e.promo_id
    left join "bramblewood"."main"."int_claim_totals" as c on p.promo_id = c.promo_id
),

estimates as (
    select
        *,
        cast(case
            when status = 'Cancelled' then 0
            when ambiguous_sales_rows > 0 then null
            else unambiguous_eligible_units * vendor_scan_per_unit
        end as decimal(18, 2)) as scan_funding_owed_estimate,
        cast(case
            when status = 'Approved' and display = 'Y' then vendor_display_fee
            else 0
        end as decimal(18, 2)) as display_funding_owed_estimate
    from event_inputs
),

funding as (
    select
        *,
        cast(scan_funding_owed_estimate + display_funding_owed_estimate as decimal(18, 2)) as funding_owed_estimate
    from estimates
)

select

        when eligible_sales_rows = 0 then 'no_observed_sales'
        when discounted_sales_rows = 0 then 'no_discount_execution_signal'

from funding

select
    p.store_id,
    p.sku_id,

    p.facings,

    s.sales_key is not null as has_sales_record,
    s.net_sales,
    s.units,
    s.gross_profit_before_funding,
    s.net_sales / nullif(p.facings, 0) as sales_per_scheduled_facing
from "bramblewood"."main"."int_planogram_schedule" as p
left join "bramblewood"."main"."fct_sales" as s
    on
        p.store_id = s.store_id
        and p.sku_id = s.sku_id
        and p.week_key = s.week_key

select
    s.week_key,
    w.fiscal_year,
    w.fiscal_week,
    i.subcategory,
    cast(sum(s.units) as bigint) as net_units,
    cast(sum(s.net_sales) as decimal(18, 2)) as net_sales,
    cast(sum(s.gross_profit_before_funding) as decimal(18, 2)) as gross_profit_before_funding,
    cast(sum(s.promo_discount) as decimal(18, 2)) as promo_discount,
    count(distinct s.store_id) as reporting_stores
from "bramblewood"."main"."fct_sales" as s
join "bramblewood"."main"."dim_item" as i using (sku_id)
join "bramblewood"."main"."dim_week" as w using (week_key)
group by all

with actuals as (
    select
        sku_id,
        week_key,
        cast(sum(units) as bigint) as actual_units,
        count(distinct store_id) as reporting_stores
    from "bramblewood"."main"."fct_sales"
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    f.sku_id,
    f.week_key,
    f.forecast_run_week,
    f.forecast_units,
    a.actual_units,
    a.reporting_stores,
    a.week_key is not null as has_actual,
    f.forecast_units - a.actual_units as error_units,
    abs(f.forecast_units - a.actual_units) as absolute_error_units,
    
        (date_diff('day', r.week_start::timestamp, w.week_start::timestamp ))
    
    / 7 as lead_weeks
from "bramblewood"."main"."stg_forecast" as f
left join actuals as a on f.sku_id = a.sku_id and f.week_key = a.week_key
left join "bramblewood"."main"."dim_week" as w on f.week_key = w.week_key
left join "bramblewood"."main"."dim_week" as r on f.forecast_run_week = r.week_key

-- Full outer join preserves missing observations; absence never means zero.
select
    coalesce(s.store_id, i.store_id) as store_id,
    coalesce(s.sku_id, i.sku_id) as sku_id,
    coalesce(s.week_key, i.week_key) as week_key,
    s.sales_key is not null as has_sales_record,
    i.inventory_key is not null as has_inventory_record,
    s.units,
    s.net_sales,
    i.on_hand_eow,
    i.receipts_units,
    i.zero_stock_snapshot
from "bramblewood"."main"."fct_sales" as s full outer join "bramblewood"."main"."fct_inventory" as i
    on s.store_id = i.store_id and s.sku_id = i.sku_id and s.week_key = i.week_key
